div.head: II Em 7.1
div.ab: Ðonne syððan gebyreð, þæt man sylle ðæs slagan forspecan on hand, ðæt se slaga mote mid griðe nyr ⁊ sylf wæres weddian.
Ðonne syððan gebyreð, þæt man sylle ðæs slagan forspecan on hand, þæt se slaga mote mid griðe nyr ⁊ sylf wæres weddian.
Deinde oportet, ut prolocutori detur in manu, cur interfector audeat accedere cum pace et ipse weram uadiare.
Ðonne syððan gebyreð þæt man sylle ðæs slagan forspecan on hand, þæt se slaga mote mid griðe nyr ⁊ sylf wæres weddian.
After that it is incumbent upon the kin of the slain man to give security to the slayer's advocate, that he [the slayer] may approach under safe-conduct and pledge himself to pay the wergeld.
Then afterwards it is fitting that a pledge be given to the slayer’s advocate, that the slayer may approach under safe-conduct and himself pledge to pay the wergild.

Darauf nun gebührt sich, dass man [die beleidigte Sippe] dem Fürsprech des Todtschlägers in die Hand gelobe, dass der Todtschläger unter [Geleit-]sicherheit näher [kommen] und selbst sich zu Wergeld[zahlung] rechtsförmlich verpflichten dürfe.

After that it is fitting that [the injured kindred] give a pledge into the hand of the slayer's advocate that the slayer may [come] nearer under [safe-conduct] protection and himself formally pledge [payment of] the wergild.
